text:
Jordan (Sales): Aurora sent SIG v2 with ~80 Qs, EOD Fri. Need a point-by-point pack. Who can own?
Maya (SolutionsEng): I can take SIG_Q_0010 to SIG_Q_040 (architecture, networking, access controls). I'll craft short plain-language answers + attachments.
Vince (InfoSec): I'll take SIG_Q_0410 to SIG_Q_080 (encryption, key mgmt, vuln mgmt). Need SOC2 + pentest artifacts.
Rebecca (Compliance): I'll do final read for any legal/export wording and check our canned answers for SIG alignment.
Jordan (Sales): @Sam any constraints from Aurora risk team? ZIP upload vs links? Are there any questions they want expanded?
Sam (Aurora Capital): ZIP preferred. Please call out BYOK and EU data residency explicitly. Also include pen-test vendor + date.
Maya (SolutionsEng): plan: short answers (1-2 lines) per question, then evidence filenames. Example mapping I'll use:
```
SIG_Q_001: redwood-arch-v3.pdf
SIG_Q_005: network-segmentation.png
SIG_Q_012: bastion-access-flow.txt
SIG_Q_020: sso-saml-metadata.xml
SIG_Q_028: scim-provisioning-sample.json
```
Vince (InfoSec): For KMS questions I'll provide two variants: Hosted and Private. Files I will attach:
- kms-overview.md
- kms-rotation-202502.log
- hsm-csr-2024.pem (private deployments)
- key-access-roles.csv
Also: SOC2-TypeII-2024.pdf and redfence-summary-20250114.pdf (external pentest).
Rebecca (Compliance): When you write answers, reference SIG IDs exactly (e.g., "SIG_Q_045") so reviewers can map quickly. I'll check for any confidentiality redactions before upload.
Jordan (Sales): Evidence-bot, please create a temp package folder and set ACL so Aurora gets read-only once we upload.
evidence-bot: Folder created at https://r-secure.internal/sigs/aurora_capital/1780024680 (redacted). ACLs set to internal editors + eventual external read-only.
Maya (SolutionsEng): Quick Q re: data residency wording. For Hosted we have per-customer region setting for embeddings; Dedicated/Private allow EU-only regions. How explicit should we be?
Sam (Aurora Capital): Be explicit: say "eu-west-1, eu-central-1 available for Dedicated/Private; Hosted can be configured to store embeddings in EU region upon request". Also include the contract addendum filename.
Maya (SolutionsEng): Noted. I'll include data-residency-amendment-2024.docx in the ZIP.
Vince (InfoSec): Vulnerability cadence: monthly authenticated scans + weekly agent alerts. Remediation SLA: High <= 30 days, Critical emergency process. Backup RTO/RPO: RTO 4h / RPO 1h for critical metadata. TLS: min 1.2, prefer 1.3. Cert rotation 90d.
Rebecca (Compliance): I'll draft polished answers for the high-level policy questions and attach the SOC2 + pen-test summary.
Jordan (Sales): Timeline: Maya draft by 11:45, Vince by 12:15, Rebecca review by 13:00, Jordan to package and upload by 13:30. Sound good?
Maya (SolutionsEng): Yes. I'll drop a draft bundle to the folder and add a README mapping questions to files.
Vince (InfoSec): Dropping artifacts now: kms-rotation-202502.log, key-access-roles.csv, redfence-summary-20250114.pdf.
Maya (SolutionsEng): Uploaded draft bundle (v0.1) and README at the folder.
evidence-bot: Uploaded files: redwood-arch-v3.pdf, network-segmentation.png, kms-overview.md, data-residency-amendment-2024.docx, README-sig-mapping.md.
Rebecca (Compliance): Reviewing now. Will flag export-controlled bits and check liability language.
Sam (Aurora Capital): Thanks. One last ask: can you produce a one-page executive summary of controls for procurement?
Jordan (Sales): Yep, we'll add an "Executive Controls Summary" PDF to the ZIP before upload.
Rebecca (Compliance): Signed off on the public-facing wording pending one small redaction (internal SSH key reference).
Vince (InfoSec): Redaction done. All artifacts ready for packaging.
Jordan (Sales): Uploading ZIP to SIG portal now, setting file name: aurora_sig_package_1780024680.zip. Will post confirmation.
evidence-bot: ZIP created and uploaded to portal. Link (redacted): https://sig-portal.vendor/aurora/1780024680 (read-only link generated).
Sam (Aurora Capital): Received. Thanks team, procurement will review and we may have a follow-up on a couple of control details.
Jordan (Sales): Great job everyone. I'll keep this thread for follow-ups and log any follow-up Qs as new threads per SIG question ID. :rocket:
